title: kithd: GET /jmap/download/{accountId}/{blobId}/{name} download handler
description:
What: Implement the JMAP blob download endpoint that authenticates caller, validates blobId, and streams blob to client.

Algorithm:
1. Add route GET /jmap/download/:account_id/:blob_id/:name to build_app.
2. Handler: verify caller.role == Role::Owner OR (Role::Peer AND blob is in a message addressed to caller). For Phase 2, allow owner only to start; peer access can be added later if needed.
3. Verify account_id == app.owner_id; else 400.
4. Call validate_blob_id(&blob_id); return 400 if invalid.
5. Lookup attachment metadata: store.attachments().get_blob_meta(&blob_id) -> Option<BlobMeta>. Return 404 if not found.
6. Call app.blob_store.read_blob(&blob_id) -> Option<Vec<u8>>. Return 404 if not found on disk.
7. Read ?accept= query param if present (max 256 bytes); use as Content-Type if provided, else use stored content_type.
8. Return 200 with Content-Type header, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename={sanitized name from URL}, body = blob bytes.
9. Sanitize the :name URL segment for response header: strip path separators, null bytes, limit to 255 chars.

Defensive rules: validate_blob_id before any file I/O; return 404 not 403 for unauthorized blob access; sanitize filename from URL for Content-Disposition; never log blob content.

Agent team: R reads existing download_url template in kith-jmap; I implements; T writes integration test: upload blob then download it, verify bytes identical; V runs cargo test -p kithd + clippy.
